SELECT strftime(o.first_order_ts, '%Y-%m') AS month
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order_ts
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
) o
GROUP BY strftime(o.first_order_ts, '%Y-%m')
